title: ECoG_Tonal_Speech_Perception
description: Electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings collected at Huashan Hospital during perception of tonal speech. The signal provided is the high-gamma amplitude envelope (70-150 Hz Hilbert transform) rather than raw voltage, converted from NWB to EDF and organized in BIDS format. The dataset accompanies a Scientific Data publication and supports investigation of neural encoding of lexical tone in speech perception.
methods_description: Original NWB iEEG series were processed by the authors to derive the 70-150 Hz Hilbert high-gamma envelope, then exported to EDF with values stored in microvolts. Round-trip conversion error per file is documented in convert_report.json. One misnamed duplicate NWB file (sub-01 ses-05 run-05) was excluded.
